headline: Apple hit by outage affecting iCloud and other services
summary: Apple suffered an outage affecting multiple services, including iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, iCloud Mail, Account & Sign In, Apple School Manager and Schoolwork. Apple's status page confirmed the disruptions but had not confirmed a cause, and the full extent of the outage was not yet known.
